notes:
{看過|かんか} means to overlook or ignore something, often used critically to indicate negligence.

WRITING:
- {看|かん} (watch, look)
- {過|か} (pass by, exceed)

USAGE:
- {看過|かんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to overlook - suru verb)
- {看過|かんか}⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (cannot overlook)
- {看過|かんか}し⟦{得|え}ない→得る：02014_eru⟧ (cannot be allowed to pass)
- Often used in negative contexts
- Implies criticism of inaction
- Formal/written style

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{看過|かんか}⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (cannot overlook ~)
- {看過|かんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧わけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はいかない (cannot let it pass)
- {看過|かんか}し⟦{難|がた}い→難い：17198_gatai⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (a problem difficult to ignore)

REGISTER:
- Literary/formal expression
- Common in news, official statements
